name: Shared World
description: One world for several Game mode adventures, each played at its own pace. Create a shared game, add its players, and link each player's Game mode chat to it right after setup: the first chat seeds the world and later ones join it. Characters, maps, discovered places, invented items and the world overview stay in sync between the linked chats; chat history, reputation, the story arc and the party's position stay each player's own. Each Game Master hears what the other parties changed as news. Works on a stock Marinara Engine. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Shared World.
